description: This file defines the Smarty_Template_Source class, which represents a source template in the Smarty templating system. It encapsulates metadata and methods for handling template sources, including loading templates, retrieving timestamps, and content.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Source
classes.description: A class representing a template source in Smarty, providing metadata and methods for managing template files and their content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Smarty_Template_Source object with the given Smarty instance, resource identifier, type, and name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to initialize a Smarty_Template_Source object from a Smarty template or parameters, handling resource parsing and handler population.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the source, populating it via the handler if not already set.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the template source, fetching via the handler if not already set.
